title: Files and configuration
objective: Create and inspect a configuration without changing another file.
instructions: Write service.env with PORT=8080 and MODE=dev on separate lines. Inspect it with cat. Run help to see the available commands. Files in this lab persist between runs.

initialFiles.README.txt: Private training files. No production credentials.

checks.description: The configuration has the required port and mode.

checks.equals: Private training files. No production credentials.

title: Investigate service logs
objective: Filter and deduplicate real log records through a bounded pipeline.
instructions: Read logs/service.log. Select ERROR records, sort and deduplicate them into errors.txt. Confirm the result with cat or wc -l. grep matches literal substrings here, without regular-expression flags.

initialFiles.logs/service.log:
INFO start
ERROR timeout
ERROR bad-token
ERROR timeout

starter:
grep ERROR logs/service.log | sort | uniq > errors.txt
cat errors.txt

checks.description: The two distinct error records are present in sorted order.

title: Promote an artifact by digest
objective: Copy the same artifact and record a digest of the delivered bytes.
instructions: Copy src/app.conf to release/app.conf, then record its sha256sum in release/digest.txt. This command emits a digest only. The lab checks the actual bytes and digest independently.
starter:
cp src/app.conf release/app.conf
sha256sum release/app.conf > release/digest.txt
cat release/digest.txt

checks.description: The promoted artifact matches its original source.
The recorded digest describes the promoted bytes.

title: Gate a rollout on readiness
objective: Distinguish a blocked gate from a passing one using actual lab state.
instructions: Run the starter before creating a ready flag: it should write blocked. Then create health/ready.flag and run the gate again. A real deployment also needs a fresh response from the actual target; this local file contract does not claim a Kubernetes rollout.

initialFiles.health/README.txt: Create ready.flag only after the local contract is satisfied.

starter:
if test -f health/ready.flag; then
  echo healthy > rollout.txt
else
  echo blocked > rollout.txt
fi
cat rollout.txt

title: Recover configuration, preserve writes
objective: Restore the faulty configuration while retaining accepted data.
instructions: Inspect live/settings.conf and backups/settings.conf. Restore only the configuration. Preserve live/accepted-writes.log byte-for-byte. This is a local restore rehearsal, not proof of a database point-in-time recovery.
starter:
cat live/settings.conf
cat backups/settings.conf
# Restore only the configuration, then inspect accepted writes.

checks.description: The live configuration matches the original backup.

title: A repeatable verification script
objective: Run a real local script and inspect its evidence and exit status.
instructions: Inspect verify.sh, then run it before promotion and observe failure. Copy the production configuration to release/app.conf and run sh verify.sh again. The checks inspect evidence.txt and the delivered digest. This shell has no cloud runners or credentials.

initialFiles.verify.sh: test -f release/app.conf && grep MODE=prod release/app.conf > evidence.txt && sha256sum release/app.conf > release/digest.txt

checks.description: The artifact matches the original source.
The verification script recorded the production contract.
The digest matches the delivered artifact.
